parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Input limits:

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG, or BMP.
- Image size: up to 4 MB.
- Image resolution: greater than 10 × 10 pixels, less than 2000 × 2000 pixels, and the longest side must be less than 2000 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
- Image quality recommendation: suitable for portrait images with most skin types. The effect may be limited for images with severe blemishes, acne, or low exposure.

parameters.name: Sharp
parameters.description: The sharpening (clarity) level. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value closer to 1 indicates a higher sharpening level.

parameters.name: Smooth
parameters.description: The smoothing level. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value closer to 1 indicates a higher smoothing level.

parameters.name: White
parameters.description: The whitening level. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value closer to 1 indicates a higher whitening level.
